en: The front of the postcard shows a black-and-white photographic image of a grand baroque-style building with a landscaped terrace and a stone bridge over a reflective body of water. The building is surrounded by lush trees. The text at the top reads 'BAD PYRMONT Fürstl. Schloss', suggesting the depicted site is a princely (fürstlich) palace or castle in Bad Pyrmont, Germany. The back of the postcard is typical for older German postcards, with the word 'POSTKARTE', dividing lines for the address, a museum stamp, and publishing credits.
